Load projection baseline data from Excel or RDS

load_projection_baseline.Rd

Loads descriptive analysis results required to run the projection module. The input can be either an Excel workbook (`IO_Analysis_Output.xlsx`) or an RDS file produced by the descriptive analysis module.

Usage

load_projection_baseline(path, projection_area_file_bau)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to the descriptive analysis file. Supported extensions are `.xlsx`, `.xls`, and `.rds`.

projection_area_file_bau

Character. Path to the BAU land projection file (Excel/CSV) containing columns `ID`, `LC`, and one column per projection year.

Value

A list containing:

gdp_baseline

Tibble of baseline GDP and related coefficients

leontief_matrix

Leontief inverse matrix

full_io_table

Complete IO matrix

code_registry

Code registry tibble

sector_idx

Index of sector rows in the IO table

income_multiplier

Income multiplier table

labour_multiplier

Labour multiplier table

SUB_multiplier

Gross operating surplus multiplier table

output_multiplier

Output multiplier table

linkage_table

Linkage table

land_prop

Land proportion matrix

P_default

Default land proportion matrix

growth_rate

Baseline growth rate data

area_matrix_bau

BAU area matrix

projection_area_bau

Raw BAU land projection table

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
baseline <- load_projection_baseline(
  path = "output/descriptive_analysis_module.rds",
  projection_area_file_bau = "data/luc_projection_bau.xlsx"
)
} # }
